entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Ancient stone monoliths on Zendikar that, aligned, bind the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who constructed the hedron network; later compleated by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker who guided Nahiri in shaping the hedrons.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans and their brood imprisoned on Zendikar by the hedron network.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane covered by the hedron network.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan trapped by the hedrons.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose troops held a city against Ulamog.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker whose forces held the city against Ulamog.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who raised sunken hedrons around Ulamog.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who activated the hedrons to trap Ulamog and moved a hedron from Nixilis to Garruk.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who undid the hedron network and had a hedron implanted in his forehead.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: A planeswalker cursed by the Chain Veil who received a hedron in his chest.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact whose curse affected Ob Nixilis and Garruk.

entities.name: Sarkhan
entities.description: A planeswalker who used a hedron shard to protect Ugin.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who battled Sarkhan and Ugin.

entities.name: Emeria Skyclave
entities.description: Location where compleated Nahiri began realigning the hedrons.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's wild upheaval, which rose to meet Nahiri and was defeated.

entities.name: Seagate
entities.description: A city defeated once more as Phyrexians poured into Zendikar.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Zendikar in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

events.summary: Nahiri constructs the network of hedrons over forty years to imprison the Eldrazi, with Ugin guiding her.
events.quote: Nahiri constructed the hedrons during a period of 40 years

events.summary: Nissa raises sunken hedrons around Ulamog and Jace activates them, trapping the titan.
events.quote: Jace Beleren activated the hedrons, thus trapping Ulamog.

events.summary: The hedron network is undone by Ob Nixilis.
events.quote: the network was then undone by Ob Nixilis .

events.summary: Compleated Nahiri realigns the hedrons at the Emeria Skyclave to help Realmbreaker's incursion; the Roil is defeated.
events.quote: The now- compleated planeswalker Nahiri arrived at the Emeria Skyclave and began realigning the plane's hedrons

events.summary: Nahiri implants a hedron in cursed Ob Nixilis's forehead, removing his ability to planeswalk and his wings.
events.quote: Nahiri implanted a small hedron in his forehead, removing his ability to planeswalk along with his wings.

events.summary: Jace moves the hedron from Nixilis into Garruk's chest to prevent his transformation.
events.quote: he removed the hedron from Nixilis' head and implanted it in Garruk's chest

events.summary: Sarkhan uses a hedron shard to protect Ugin after his battle with Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Using the shard of a shattered hedron, Sarkhan was able to protect Ugin after his fateful battle with Nicol Bolas .

relations.quote: Nahiri constructed the hedrons during a period of 40 years

relations.note: guided her in shaping the hedrons
relations.quote: Ugin guided Nahiri in shaping the surfaces of the hedrons.
a massive network connected by leylines that created a planewide prison for the Eldrazi
